hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: The crypto universe is currently in a cross‑asset stress regime with several key pairs (BTC, SOL, LTC) showing negative composite signals, elevated volatility, and adverse liquidity metrics. Even the long‑biased assets lack robust risk signals (zero vol, zero alpha) and are flagged by the institutional advisory risk score. Given the overall fragility, we tilt toward a defensive stance, scaling down exposure and applying modest negative conviction tweaks across the board.
